summary: It's raining, the frogs are out and have launched a new server. Structured changes across 22 entities this patch.

champions.name: Brand
champions.tldr: Mana restore reduced to 20–40 from 30–50.; Base damage reduced to 60–160 from 60–180.
champions.gameplayImpact: Brand loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 10% bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 10% bonus attack speed for 5–11 (lv 1–16) seconds. This is increased to 40% bonus attack speed and bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 15% bonus attack speed upon scoring a champion takedown. lines.label: Change
lines.note: New: Added a three-second cooldown for selections that are immediately rerolled to bench. This applies to every teammate except the one who has rerolled their selection, so the rerolling player can now swap back to their original selection without worrying about other teammates taking that selection away.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This does not affect bench-swapping behavior.
